title: Payments Already Received on a TRICARE Select Installment Paid by Card
content:
**Clause.** On a fee account of a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment, payments are applied to installments oldest first. For a one-time card payment on the latest installment: where the payments left once the earlier counted charges are settled reach the installment owed, the whole installment owed counts as already received; where some but less is left, what is left counts as already received; otherwise nothing counts as already received. What counts as already received on the latest installment is taken off the installment owed.

Here the earlier counted charges are the charges counted toward the past-due balance other than those of the latest installment, and the payments are every payment posted on the fee account.

## Condition - judgement - result

| Payments left after the earlier counted charges | Already received on the latest installment |
|---|---|
| equal to or more than the installment owed | the whole installment owed |
| more than zero but less than the installment owed | what is left |
| zero or less (the earlier charges are not fully settled) | nothing |

## Hypothetical figures (installment owed 297.54, earlier counted charges 495.90)

| Payments posted | Left after the earlier charges | Already received |
|---|---|---|
| 900.00 | 404.10 | 297.54 (the whole installment owed) |
| 793.44 | 297.54 | 297.54 (exactly reaches it) |
| 600.00 | 104.10 | 104.10 |
| 400.00 | none (95.90 of the earlier charges unsettled) | 0.00 |
